title: What Earns a Server
description: Only what exists only inside OpenKaava gets a server.
body: If the harness can already do it, it does not get a server. No file reading, writing or listing, no search, no git. Every agent worth pointing at OpenKaava arrives with those, and a second worse copy costs a permission surface and a pile of tool descriptions competing for the model's attention. What earns a server is something that exists only inside OpenKaava and has no filesystem equivalent.
